file-read.comment: The read file content is corrupted by error prints.

shell.code:
ip netns add foo
ip netns exec foo /bin/sh
ip netns delete foo

suid.code:
ip netns add foo
ip netns exec foo /bin/sh -p
ip netns delete foo

shell.version: This only works for Linux with `CONFIG_NET_NS=y`.

shell.code:
ip netns add foo
ip netns exec foo /bin/ln -s /proc/1/ns/net /var/run/netns/bar
ip netns exec bar /bin/sh
ip netns delete foo
ip netns delete bar
shell.version: This only works for Linux with `CONFIG_NET_NS=y`.
